_comment: HYLON dual-swirl H2/air coaxial injector, Flame A, reconstructed. The
published mesh is an external dataset the tutorial only links to, and
the case README gives no dimensions at all -- it points at Aniello et
al., Combustion and Flame 249 (2023) 112595 for the rig. So this is a
reconstruction of the right kind of burner, not of that one.
The injector internals are not resolved. The domain starts at the
injector exit plane, which is split into two concentric inlet patches:
a central hydrogen jet and the annulus of swirled air around it. That
sidesteps the one thing this block topology cannot express, the lip
separating the two streams inside the injector, and it is how such a
case is normally set up when the injector internals are not the object
Dimensions are representative of a laboratory coaxial hydrogen swirl
injector: 6 mm fuel bore, 20 mm air annulus outer diameter, discharging
into a 100 mm confinement. They are stated assumptions, not measurements.

segments._comment: confinement chamber; z = 0 is the injector exit plane
